notes.title: Version 0.2.0 Released 4/7/21
notes.notes:
update 0.2.0

Hello, Commanders,
The details of this version are as follows:
Main features

 New Missions: Road to English Channel, Operation Barbarossa ⅠⅠ
 Operation Barbarossa Ⅰ: adjust the number of friendly forces, wingmen, and enemy forces, add the countdown to failure in the final defensive object
 New Vehicle: StuG III Ausf. A
 Optimized adjustments for grass, tree, building and belt

Battle

 Optimized the pathfinding to avoid AI vehicles colliding with players
 When the wingman is too far away from the player, it will teleport to the player’s vicinity
 Fixed the damage of T-34
 Fixed the issue that the searching distance of S35 was too short
 Fixed Matilda ricocheting too easily when it was hit
 Fixed the collision range of TKS
 Fixed the determination of birth range to solve the issue that some enemies were not born
 The smoke add the effect that enemy's attack will have a high probability of missing
 Wingman formation: add parking command, V-shaped formation changed to wedge formation
 The turret has a chance to blow up when the vehicle is destroyed
 After the vehicle is destroyed, it will be removed under certain conditions after a fixed period of time
 New anti-tank gun: 2 pounder gun、M-37、Zis-2、Pak36、Flak36

UI

 Adjust the main battle UI
 Add wingman avatar
 Added blinking animation to the main avatar of the character in battle
 Add new loading pictures

Others

 Added contents of the bubble in battle
 Add text speed option
 Add shadow quality option
 Add brightness option
 Added a switch to remove dead vehicles
 Added iron cross camouflage to the tank
 New object decorations for the tank
 Fixed the issue of the flickering and incorrect texture of some buildings
 Fixed the display issue of the character picture when the dialogue is switched quickly

-Joybrick

notes.title: Version 0.1.3 Released 2/2/2021
notes.notes:
update 0.1.3

Commanders,
Since the last update, the team has not only continued to develop new content, but also adjusted and added some content in response to your feedback. The details are as follows:
Battle

 Increase the penetration of AP and APCR at long distances
 The damage of HE has been revised down and the range of damage caused by explosions has been reduced, and adjusted to not bounce
 When the caliber of the shell is 2.5 times larger than the enemy’s armor value, the chance of bounce can be reduced
 Adjust the probability of some speaking in battle
 Increase the vision and searching distance of the AI ​​tank
 Fixed AI tanks that can attack when they are outside their vision range
 Adjusted the Panzer II and TKS to the cannon version
 Added invalid mouse clicks within 0.5 seconds after the cut-scene dialogue ends to prevent accidental firing
 Try to fix the problem that the enemy does not appear in some missions
 Adjust deployment of Soviet army tank and wingman's models in Operation Barbarossa Ⅰ
 Fixed part of the fence will block the shells in Pass the Ardennes 
 Fixed the issue where the third crew member could not be displayed in the battle of Panzer II
 Fix some crash issues

Others

 Update skill icon
 Added mouse axis inversion and sensitivity setting
 Language can be changed during battle
 Fixed the issue that the setting cannot be saved after changing
 Fixed the issue that the saves cannot be displayed when the name is changing
 UI adjustment

-Joybrick

notes.title: Update Released - Garage, Camp and New Missions
notes.notes:
Hello, Commanders,

It's the first main update for Panzer Knights, below are the details:

Main features

Three new missions: Fall Weiss, Pass the Ardennes, Occupy Boulogne-sur-Mer
Add available tanks, the currently available list is as follows: Pz.Kpfw.38(t), Panzer II Ausf. D, Panzer III(Ausf. E, Ausf. J, Ausf. L), Panzer IV(Ausf. D, Ausf. F2, Ausf. H)、Panther(Ausf. A, Ausf. G)、Tiger I(Ausf. H, Ausf. E)
Garage system, through the medals obtained from the missions to unlock the tanks and camouflage, you can freely choose the battle vehicle
Camp system, unlock the crews through medals, and you can freely assign the crews of the tank
Memoir page, you can watch the event dialogue again
Crew skills can strengthen the tank’s abilities

Others

Mission content adjustment
UI optimization
Add grass-related screen options, volume options
New languages: Simplified Chinese, Japanese
Performance optimization, and it will proceed
bug fixed
The previous save files will not be available
Game values ​​are still being tested and will continue to be adjusted

Price adjustment
After the Valve has verified it, the price will increase to $11.99 (USD). This is the first time that Panzer Knights adjusted the price. The next and final price adjustment will be when the official version releases.

- Joy Brick

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416230/Panzer_Knights/

notes.title: Panzer Knights Big Update Information and Price Increasing
notes.notes:
Hello, Commanders,

The next update of Panzer Knights is expected to be launched around mid-January after the end of the Steam 2020 Winter Sale. There will be the following new additions:


Three new levels
Garage system, through the medals obtained from the levels to unlock the tanks and camouflage, you can freely choose the battle vehicle
Camp system, unlock the crews through medals, and you can freely assign the crews of the tank
Memoir page, you can watch the event dialogue again
Crew skills can strengthen the tank’s abilities
Add grass-related screen options, volume options
New languages: Simplified Chinese, Japanese
Performance optimization


After the update goes live, the price will be increasing to $11.99 (USD). This will be the first time that Panzer Knights has adjusted the price. In response to the winter sale, Panzer Knights will has a 10% discount during this sale. Players who are interested in the game are welcome to start during the sale period.

We need to remind everyone that after this update, the previous game saves will be unavailable, and the saves will be reset depends on the situation in subsequent major updates. In addition, the game values ​​related to tanks and skills are still not the final version and will continue to be adjusted.

Finally, we want to thank everyone in the community for your feedback and patience from the time it was launched to the present. The team will continue to improve the game, step by step to the final version, we appreciate it all.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416230/Panzer_Knights/
